translate into action: Making plans is easy, but it is much harder to translate our New Year promises into action.
訂計畫很容易，但要把新年許下的承諾化為行動就難多了。
translate into higher profits: The shop owner hopes that better customer service will translate into higher profits by the end of the year.
店老闆希望更好的顧客服務能在年底前轉化為更高獲利。
translate a book: It took the writer two years to translate a book about Japanese history from Japanese into Chinese.
那位作家花了兩年把一本關於日本歷史的書從日文翻譯成中文。
translate ideas into reality: Our science club helps students translate ideas into reality by building real robots and simple machines.
我們的科學社幫助學生把想法化為現實，實際製作機器人和簡單機械。
translate well: Many Chinese jokes do not translate well into English because they depend on words that sound alike.
許多中文笑話翻成英文效果不好，因為它們仰賴發音相近的字。
transmit a signal: The small device on the lost hiker's backpack can transmit a signal that helps rescue teams find him.
迷路登山客背包上的小裝置能傳送訊號，幫助救難隊找到他。
transmit a disease: Mosquitoes can transmit a disease such as dengue fever, so it is important to clean up standing water.
蚊子會傳播登革熱之類的疾病，所以清除積水很重要。
transmit knowledge: Grandparents often transmit knowledge about traditional festivals and family history to the younger generation.
祖父母常把傳統節慶和家族歷史的知識傳承給年輕一代。
transmit live: The TV station will transmit the final game of the World Baseball Classic live tomorrow night.
電視台明晚將現場轉播世界棒球經典賽的冠軍賽。
transmit data: The weather satellite can transmit data back to Earth every hour to help scientists predict typhoons.
氣象衛星每小時都能把資料傳輸回地球，幫助科學家預測颱風。
transport goods: Trucks and ships transport goods from factories to stores all over the island every single day.
卡車和船隻每天都把貨物從工廠運送到全島各地的商店。
be transported back in time: Walking down the old street in Lukang, I seemed to be transported back in time to my grandparents' childhood.
走在鹿港的老街上，我彷彿回到過去，回到了祖父母的童年時代。
transport passengers: The new high-speed train can transport passengers from Taipei to Kaohsiung in about ninety minutes.
新的高鐵列車大約九十分鐘就能把乘客從台北載運到高雄。
be transported with joy: The audience seemed to be transported with joy by the orchestra's music, as if carried away to another world.
觀眾似乎因管弦樂團的音樂而欣喜若狂，彷彿被帶到另一個世界。
public transport: Taking public transport such as the MRT and buses is cheaper and better for the environment than driving.
搭乘捷運和公車等大眾運輸比開車更便宜，也對環境更好。
be trapped in a job: He felt like a bird in a cage and did not want to be trapped in a job he hated for the rest of his life.
他覺得自己像籠中鳥，不想一輩子被困在一份他討厭的工作裡。
trap heat: Greenhouse gases in the air trap heat from the sun, which makes the Earth warmer every year.
空氣中的溫室氣體會困住來自太陽的熱氣，使地球一年比一年暖。
trap a mouse: We put some cheese in a small box to trap a mouse that had been eating our bread at night.
我們在小盒子裡放了些起司，來捕捉那隻晚上一直偷吃我們麵包的老鼠。
fall into a trap: Be careful when you shop online, or you may fall into a trap set by people selling fake products.
網路購物要小心，否則你可能會落入賣假貨的人所設的陷阱。
trapped in traffic: We were trapped in traffic on the highway for three hours during the long holiday weekend.
連假週末期間，我們在高速公路上塞在車陣中三個小時。
trap someone into: The clever salesman tried to trap my grandmother into signing a long contract by offering her a free gift.
那名狡猾的推銷員想用免費贈品誘使我奶奶簽下一份長期合約。
a trap door: In the old castle, the actors disappeared through a trap door in the floor of the stage.
在那座古堡裡，演員們從舞台地板上的一扇活板門消失了。
news travels fast: In a small village, news travels fast, so everyone knew about the wedding before the invitations were sent.
在小村莊裡消息傳得很快，所以喜帖還沒寄出，大家就都知道婚禮的事了。
light travels: Light travels much faster than sound, so we see lightning before we hear the thunder.
光傳播得比聲音快得多，所以我們先看到閃電，再聽到雷聲。
travel light: We decided to travel light through Japan for two weeks, carrying only a small backpack each.
我們決定輕裝旅行，在日本玩兩週，每人只帶一個小背包。
travel well: Fresh strawberries do not travel well, so they often get soft and damaged during long trips by truck.
新鮮草莓經不起長途運送，所以用卡車長途載運時常常變軟受損。
travel the world: After they retire, my grandparents plan to travel the world and visit at least twenty different countries.
我的祖父母退休後計畫環遊世界，至少去二十個不同的國家。
well-traveled: My uncle is a well-traveled man who has visited over fifty countries and loves to share stories about them.
我叔叔是個見多識廣的人，去過五十多個國家，而且喜歡分享那些地方的故事。
